# Heart to Heart — Child Enrollment Form: Field Mapping (v1.3.0, form 1.3.0-E2)

*Generated by `tools/gen-field-mapping.mjs` from `enrollment/schema.json` and `enrollment/i18n/en.mjs`. The same schema drives the browser form, the server validation and the PDF, so this table is the contract between all three.*

**Coverage:** 200 fields/sub-fields (117 can be required, 80 are conditional) across 14 data steps, plus 9 signing acknowledgments and 2 e-signatures. Languages: English, Español, Français, العربية (RTL), Kiswahili.

## How the pieces fit
- **Order of steps:** Welcome → Child → Parents/guardians → Emergency contacts → Authorized pickup → Health (with optional insurance) → Supporting documents (optional uploads) → Family → Personality → Feeding/sleeping/potty → Emergency transportation → School transportation (conditional) → Photo & media consent → Agreements and policies (Absent Days Policy, Withdrawal and Termination Policy) → **Parent/Provider Contract (its own step, the last page before review)** → Review → Sign and submit.
- **Conditional logic** is evaluated by one shared engine (`core.mjs`) in the browser and on the server. Answers to fields that are hidden are discarded, so stale answers never reach the PDF or the database.
- **“Same as” shortcuts:** parent address = child address, parent home phone = child home phone, school pick-up = child home address; "N/A" for work and for free-text questions the family has nothing to add to.
- **Not preselected:** emergency transportation (two exclusive options), media internal / marketing, every handbook / resources / transition receipt.
- **Consolidations and deferrals vs. the scanned packet:** the packet’s repeated address / phone blocks are consolidated via the “same as” shortcuts; the old work address/city are optional; the Parent Handbook and the community-resources/transition documents are not in the repository, so families mark them “received” or “pending”; the Parent/Provider Contract and Absent Days Policy are acknowledged as *to be provided for review and signature* until management approves final wording; immunization, health-care plan, special-diet statement and medicine authorization are tracked as *have / bring later / school has it / provider will send / exemption*.
- **Two PDFs (1.2.1), one application, one reference number:** "Ohio" = *Ohio Child Enrollment and Health Records* (`H2H_[ApplicationID]_Ohio_Enrollment.pdf`, content-equivalent of DCY 01234 Rev. 7/2026); "Heart to Heart" = *Internal Enrollment Records* (`H2H_[ApplicationID]_Heart_to_Heart.pdf`, 28 sections, Parent/Provider Contract last). Uploaded files are never embedded in either PDF; only their status prints. A field marked **Ohio + Heart to Heart** prints in both. Each PDF is US Letter, unencrypted, with labels in English, the family’s answers exactly as written (Arabic is shaped, right-aligned and searchable), page x of y and a confidential footer. Signatures print in both. Field trips are not covered (trip-specific permission stays separate). The test `enrollment/test/pdf-coverage.mjs` proves every answered field is printed in the PDF(s) assigned here.
